note: The road to the platinum, built from the official trophy descriptions alone: chapter and mission names, collectible counts and character strands all come from the list itself. Nothing here has been checked in the game. Work the stages in order; later stages stay open after the story ends.

stages.blurb: Play the opening chapters and earn the first story trophies as they come. One job before Chapter 1 ends: meditate at the Chapter 1 spot for Positive Mental Attitude — the one trophy reported as possibly missable.
stages.title: 1 · Story first — Chapters 1–2

stages.blurb: Finish the campaign. Every trophy in this stage is unmissable: chapter trophies and named story missions pop as you play. Between missions, take the side strands that open up so they do not all pile up at the end.
stages.title: 2 · Story — Chapters 3–5 and the finale

stages.blurb: The strangers of Leonida. Finish the final mission for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, hunt with Bret, and the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks mostly take care of themselves along the way.
stages.title: 3 · Strangers & friends

stages.blurb: Two trophies need your partner beside you. Build a four-star wanted level together and escape it for one; rob three shops in a row without losing the wanted level for the other. Plan the route before the first robbery.
stages.title: 4 · With your partner

stages.blurb: The robbery set: a jewelry store done quietly, five bank vaults, one armored truck, and one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs. Plan each getaway before the robbery, not after it.
stages.title: 5 · Robberies

stages.blurb: The skill and activity set. Gold all 42 shooting-range challenges, win races and drone races, try every activity type once, and let the 250 stunts accumulate as you travel. The bowling alley covers two trophies in one visit.
stages.title: 6 · Activities & skill

stages.blurb: The long sweep of Leonida. Meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK scans, vehicles, challenges and all 52 map areas — do them together, one region at a time, and the counters in this guide track each one.
stages.title: 7 · Collectibles & the map

stages.blurb: The mop-up. Launder $250,000, spend $100,000, buy all eight garages, raise both characters' Strength, chase the 500 criminal-profile actions, try the mystery trophies — and when the 100% checklist is done, the platinum is yours.
stages.title: 8 · Money, mysteries & the platinum
